headline: Japan restaurant operator Skylark pursues further acquisitions after ramen deal
summary: Skylark plans to pursue additional mergers and acquisitions following its recent ramen chain takeover, forecasting a 17% increase in operating profit to 35 billion yen for 2026.
why: Skylark is one of Japan's largest family restaurant chains; consolidation in domestic food service reflects shifting demographics and wage pressures.

impacts.name: Skylark Holdings
impacts.why: The company expects operating profit to rise 17% to 35 billion yen supported by network expansion.
